สัปดาห์ที่ 11: MQTT Cloud Communication and Control
(อ้างอิง ESP32-C3 Wireless Adventure - Chapter 9)

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
1. สถาปัตยกรรม Cloud Control & โปรโตคอล MQTT
- WAN vs LAN Architecture
- Publish/Subscribe Pattern
- Topics, Wildcards & QoS 0/1/2
- Packet Structure & LWT

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:

- Mosquitto Broker บน Windows/Linux
- คอมโพเนนต์ esp-mqtt & Event Loop
- JSON Telemetry & Actuator Control

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:

- PKI, X.509 & OpenSSL Keys/Certs
- Mosquitto MQTTS Broker (Port 8883)
- ESP-IDF Embedded PEM Certificates
- Mutual Authentication (mTLS)

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:

- Assisted Claiming & AWS IoT Backend
- RainMaker Phone App & RainMaker CLI
- Alexa & Google Home Integration
